content.short: Tarot is a decentralized lending protocol where lenders supply tokens to isolated pools and borrowers use LP tokens as collateral for leveraged yield farming.
content.description: Tarot is a decentralized lending protocol that operates with isolated lending pools, allowing lenders and borrowers to interact within separate markets. Lenders provide liquidity by depositing individual tokens into a pool, earning a passive yield with no impermanent loss risk. Borrowers may use LP tokens as collateral to borrow from a pool, enabling leveraged yield farming and higher LP rewards, while each pool remains insulated from the others.
